description: This file declares functions related to distributed tensor operations such as all_reduce, all_gather, reduce_scatter, and broadcast within the c10d namespace. These functions facilitate collective communication in distributed PyTorch training.

methods.name: all_reduce_
methods.description: Performs an in-place all-reduce operation on the input tensor with the specified reduce operation and group name.

methods.name: all_reduce
methods.description: Performs an all-reduce operation on the input tensor with the specified reduce operation and group name, returning a new tensor.

methods.name: all_reduce_coalesced_
methods.description: Performs an in-place coalesced all-reduce operation on a vector of tensors with specified reduce operation and group name.

methods.name: all_reduce_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced all-reduce operation on a vector of tensors with specified reduce operation and group name, returning vector of tensors.

methods.name: all_gather_into_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced all-gather into tensors operation on input tensors with specified group size and group name.

methods.name: all_gather_into_tensor
methods.description: Gathers tensors from all processes into a tensor with specified group size and group name.

methods.name: all_gather_into_tensor_out
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation into an existing output tensor.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced reduce-scatter operation on input tensors with specified reduce operation, group size, and group name.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor
methods.description: Performs a reduce-scatter operation on an input tensor with specified reduce operation, group size, and group name.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_out
methods.description: Performs an out-parameter reduce-scatter tensor operation.

methods.name: all_to_all_single
methods.description: Performs a single tensor all-to-all communication with specified input tensor, split sizes, and group name.

methods.name: broadcast_
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor from the source rank to all other ranks within the specified group.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor from the source rank to all other ranks within the specified group, returning a new tensor.
